fichas.title: Equestrian Sport
fichas.summary: Guidance and illustrated dimensions for equestrian facilities, including site selection, stables and tack storage, riding arenas, entrances, ring fences, and spectator seating. Sites should be near suitable riding land; avoid humid valleys and windless locations. Illustrated dimensions are shown alongside the text guidance.
